sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Response call from Specsavers Queen St: male inside the store being aggressive towards staff.

Arrived at Specsavers; POI had already left. Description: black hat, black shorts, black jacket, black glasses. Informed the manager we would keep an eye out; standing by outside in case the POI returns.
Response call from Jo & Joe's Fort St: male vaping inside the store; assistance requested to remove him.
Arrived; manager advised he had left but was still in the area inside Wilson Carpark on Fort St.
Spotted the male outside Wilson Carpark; advised him not to return to Jo & Joe's, he complied. Standby maintaining presence.
